posts.title: Your Location Shapes What You Create
posts.captionMatch: Every city has a rhythm—and that rhythm shapes what we create
posts.note: Published Thu 27 Aug ~10:17 Vienna (17 min late). The automated build failed with 'Private queue payload is missing' because this post never had an entry in ALIVEAWAKE_QUEUE_JSON -- its original publish used a pre-built container, so the private entry was never needed until it was rescheduled for a fresh from-scratch build. Recovered by building the container manually from the already-public GitHub release assets (media-2026-08-26-location-shapes-creation-01) and publishing. Facebook side went live 2026-08-26 at its original slot and is unchanged. LESSON: rescheduling a post for a fresh build requires confirming its ALIVEAWAKE_QUEUE_JSON entry exists.
